criteria.requirement: Implement marshmallow.error_paths.flatten_errors(error) and problem(error,*,status=422,title=...). Accept real ValidationError using normalized_messages or native dict/list/string message trees; return frozen ErrorItem(pointer,messages tuple) leaves in original traversal order. Encode JSON Pointer escaping including integer array keys, retain _schema explicitly and all messages, handle root/empty errors and reject cycles/unsupported leaves. problem returns a detached status/title/errors mapping only, never exception data/valid_data or traceback. Preserve original errors and support custom field_name normalization.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
